  h,m=map(int,str(x).split(':')); return h*60+m
 d['delay']=[(mins(a)-mins(s))%1440 if not pd.isna(a) and str(a)!='' else None for a,s in zip(d[ac],d[sc])]
 # Note modulo makes early departures negative into positive! Need distinguish raw and if actual after midnight likely only when actual clock much earlier than scheduled; early departures are negative. infer if diff<-? actual after midnight, likely add 1440 only if huge negative, but early may modest. use raw if >= -? add 1440 when diff < -? documentation actual after midnight. identify patterns. 
 raw=d.apply(lambda r: mins(r[ac])-mins(r[sc]) if pd.notna(r[ac]) and str(r[ac])!='' else None,axis=1)
 # likely if raw < -15 could be midnight delay, but early >15 possible. use date? no actual date. convention says delayed after midnight, raw negative interpreted next day when substantial. inspect negatives
 print(c, 'raw neg distribution', sorted(pd.Series(raw.dropna()).unique())[:10], 'min',min(raw.dropna()))
 d['delay']=raw
 # assume negatives <= -? are next day; use threshold -15? early departures can be -16. Need dataset likely distinguish via scheduled late and actual early clock. inspect
 d.loc[d['delay']< -30,['date','origin','dest',sc,ac,'delay']].head()
 comp=d[~cancelled]
 counts=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 stats=comp.groupby('route').agg(completed=('flight_id','size'), delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 stats['rate']=stats.delayed/stats.completed
 print('top counts',counts.head(5).to_dict(),'worst',stats[stats.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate','delayed'],ascending=False).head(5).to_dict('index'))
 out[c]={'busiest':counts.index[0], 'worst':stats[stats.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate','delayed'],ascending=False).index[0]}

import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
    car=os.path.basename(f)[:-4]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
    # verify dates perhaps all Jan Feb
    datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; sc='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; ac='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
    d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
    d['sched_min']=d[sc].str[:2].astype(int)*60+d[sc].str[3:].astype(int)
    d['actual_min']=d[ac].fillna('').map(lambda x: int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]) if x else pd.NA)
    d['delay']=d['actual_min']-d['sched_min']
    # likely no overnight weird issue; inspect negative and huge
    d['delayed']=(d['delay']>15)
    g=d.groupby('route').agg(scheduled=('flight_id','size'), completed=('cancelled',lambda x:(~x).sum()), delayed=('delayed','sum'))
    g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
    mx=g.scheduled.max(); busiest=g.index[g.scheduled==mx].tolist()
    eligible=g[g.completed>=20]; wm=eligible.rate.max(); worst=eligible.index[eligible.rate==wm].tolist()
    print('\n',car,'rows',len(d),'dups',pd.read_csv(f).flight_id.duplicated().sum(),'busiest',busiest,'worst',worst,'maxrate',wm)
    print(g.sort_values(['scheduled','rate'],ascending=False).head(10).to_string())
    out[car]={'busiest':busiest,'worst':worst}
print(out)

import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 car=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 sc=[c for c in d if 'sched' in c][0]; ac=[c for c in d if 'actual' in c][0]
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 d['delay']= (pd.to_datetime(d[ac],format='%H:%M',errors='coerce')-pd.to_datetime(d[sc],format='%H:%M',errors='coerce')).dt.total_seconds()/60
 d.loc[d.delay < -720,'delay'] += 1440
 g=d.groupby('route').agg(scheduled=('flight_id','size'), completed=('cancelled',lambda x:(~x).sum()), delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
 busiest=g.sort_values(['scheduled'],ascending=False)
 eligible=g[g.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate','delayed','completed'],ascending=[False,False,True])
 print('\n',car,'\n',g.sort_values('scheduled',ascending=False).to_string())
 print('TOP busy',busiest[busiest.scheduled==busiest.scheduled.max()].index.tolist(),'worst',eligible[eligible.rate==eligible.rate.max()].index.tolist(), 'rates',eligible.head().to_dict('index'))
 out[car]={'busiest':busiest.index[0],'worst':eligible.index[0]}
print(out)

events.notes: Loaded each carrier file, removed repeated flight_id records, canonicalized routes by alphabetically sorting the two airport codes, and counted all remaining records for busiest. For worst route, computed actual-minus-scheduled departure minutes (using the UTC clock columns for AS), treated completed flights as non-cancelled, and selected the highest delayed/completed rate among routes with at least 20 completed flights. Large negative clock differences were interpreted as post-midnight departures by adding 1,440 minutes; ordinary small negative values remained early departures.
